vuln.name: Cookies with missing, inconsistent or contradictory properties
vuln.description: At least one of the following cookies properties causes the cookie to be invalid or incompatible with either a different property of the same cookie, of with the environment the cookie is being used in. Although this is not a vulnerability in itself, it will likely lead to unexpected behavior by the application, which in turn may cause secondary security issues.
vuln.impact: Cookies will not be stored, or submitted, by web browsers.
vuln.recommendation: Ensure that the cookies configuration complies with the applicable standards.
